summary:
Implemented the Tabs feature in the repository, but nothing has been run: I was told not to run tests or repository code, so all checks were by reading.

Changes:
- src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new): Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs. Tabs owns state, keyboard handling, and the animation watcher; TabsRenderable does width arithmetic and builds the label row and underline bar. __all__ exports Tab and Tabs. Not re-exported from textual.widgets.
- src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py: adds clickable_ranges before width, yields one Text, attaches range_clicked('<name>') metadata as the last spans; zero-width early path yields background only, with no click spans.
- src/textual/renderables/opacity.py: blended colors merged with style + blended so click metadata is preserved.
- docs/reference/tabs.md (new): single ::: directive for textual.widgets.tabs.Tabs. No mkdocs nav entry added (none exists for reference pages).
- sandbox/tabs_demo.py (new): mounts two Tabs on the App.
- tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py: three new tests (click ranges in mapping order, zero-width early path has no click metadata, zero-width highlight at non-zero position gets click metadata). Existing tests unchanged.
- tests/widgets/__init__.py and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (new): tab equality/str/repr, construction (empty list and populated), active-tab initialisation, find_tab_by_name with duplicates, no-tabs row, explicit and auto-fit padding rows, duplicate names, padded-span styling and click metadata, underline highlight cells, next/previous wrap, number activation, first-character search, action_range_clicked.

Choices to review:
- Bar position uses the index among displayed (de-duplicated) tabs rather than the full-list find_tab_by_name index. The two differ only when names repeat; the displayed index keeps the underline on the correct label.
- Letter search in on_key runs only for single-character keys.
- layout_resolve's Edge protocol already had size, min_size (default 1), and fraction, so _layout_resolve.py was not changed.

Known limitations:
- A zero-cell label (empty string) gets size 0, which the shared resolver treats as flexible; no special handling was added.
- Not verified: the ANSI output expectations were derived by hand. The Opacity change relies on rich's Style addition keeping meta from the left operand when the right has none; I believe it does, but it needs a test run.
- Animation behaviour is not covered by tests (it needs an event loop, which the tests must not touch).
